svg.title: blurt — the hen that blurts it out (app mark: menu bar, tray)
svg.desc: The A hen as a solid monochrome silhouette for the menu bar (an 18 pt template image) and the tray: the head with a negative-space eye and the open beak cut into it, the three-lobe comb and the wattle apart from the head by a 1 px gap at 1x, two neck feathers, three shout strokes. Designed on a 36 grid (1 px at 2x for 18 pt) and scaled into the family's 24 grid; the eye is centred on a pixel corner, a clean 2 x 2 px hole at 1x. Generator: promo/cases/v0.8-menubar/mono-src/ (untracked); the candidates: mono-candidates.png.
